Ibiza

The original. Still the one.

The place

Ibiza is where Invenio began, and where the portfolio is deepest: whitewashed houses in the hills, long tables under the pines, and a coastline that rewards people who know it.

The island divides itself quietly. The north is greener, slower, and full of houses that have been in families for generations. The south and west hold the sunsets, the longer views and the houses built for a season of entertaining. We work across both, and we will tell you honestly which side suits the week you are planning.

Our team is on the island year-round. That means a property visit before a house is listed, a person who can open a door if a guest locks themselves out, and the kind of restaurant advice that does not come from a search engine.

  • 01

    The north

    Pine-covered hills, quiet coves and a slower rhythm — our favourite side of the island.

  • 02

    The sunsets

    Cala Comte, Es Vedrà and the west coast terraces. Book the table, then take your time.

  • 03

    The houses

    The deepest part of the portfolio: country estates, whitewashed villas and modern houses above the sea.

When to go

May — October

High season runs from late June to early September. May, June and September are quieter, warmer than you think, and often better value.
